messages.subject: [relogit] Marginal Effects
messages.body_plain:
I would like to calculate marginal effects for the relogit estimation.
However, when I run the estimation and then run 'mfx compute', the
marginal effects are equal to the coefficients given with the relogit
results, any suggestions?

 

 

Anne Anderson

McClelland Hall 309

520-621-1701

messages.subject: [relogit] Marginal Effects
messages.body_plain:
Dear Anne,

Relogit for Stata does not currently support the "mfx compute" command,
but you can use the setx and relogitq commands to calculate the effect of
changing any given variable (by any arbitrarily large or small amount),
holding the other explanatory variables constant.

Hope this helps

Regards,
Mike

messages.body_plain:
Dear Anne,

Regards,
